description: This file contains helper functions for generating GN build configuration files, including architecture name mappings and toolchain file creation.

methods.name: gn_host_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name based on the build host's architecture string.

methods.name: gn_target_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name based on the target machine's architecture override.

methods.name: write_toolchain_file
methods.description: Creates a GN toolchain file with native and target configurations.
